capability_semantics: Actor booleans are maximum role capabilities, not action authorization. Every current hard stop and action-specific gate still applies; agent-facing tools cannot authenticate an owner string and therefore remain local-only.

codex.scope: All reversible local project work: read, research, analyze, edit, refactor, draft, design systems, build, validate, and maintain continuous-improvement loops.

grok.scope: Presses publish on approved job cards. Does not write content, does not edit the repo, does not decide what goes out.
grok._what_social_publish_true_does_not_mean: capability_semantics above still governs: this is a maximum role capability, not authorization for any specific post. tools/publication_authority.py authorize_live_publication() remains the only thing that lets a post out, and it still demands the dated gates, the calendar slot and per-piece owner approval. Before 10 Sep 2026 an actor named grok did not exist here at all, so every call was refused by default=deny and the refusal looked like a channel problem. Adding the actor makes the real remaining blockers visible.
grok._known_gaps_on_the_day_it_was_added: publication_authority does not implement direct publication for pinterest or pantip. Nobody has yet tested what the Grok bot can actually reach per channel - that is a test to run, not a fact to assume in either direction.

reactivation_rule: A non-owner capability may change only through a dated owner authorization plus a passing privacy/source/policy/quota/QA/publication gate. Historical prompts never grant capability.
